meta.purpose: FlashPrefill V2 state-chain harness legs (PREFILL.md 17.3). Example runnable matrix specification for scripts/flashprefill-matrix.py. Status: NOT RUN. Unvalidated (no validation runs performed here; parent owns compilation/verification).
meta.required_server_profile: Candidate binary with FlashPrefill enabled (required mode, mean correction on), TriAttention enabled with trusted calibration, RERoT disabled (keeps these legs deterministic), KV capacity comfortably above the long-probe length (default min_kv 1024 assumed; long probes are ~2500 tokens). Short probes route dense_short_context; long probes route sparse with mean correction.
meta.requests_companion: The --requests file must define every id listed in meta.required_requests with the given endpoint/stream/timeout shape. Full example payloads are shown in meta.requests_example (documentation only; this file carries no request bodies). Long prompts are repeated neutral lines (~10 tokens/line x 256 lines) so resident-visible length deterministically exceeds min_kv.

payload.prompt: GEN:256:Record %04d: neutral reference material for state pressure.

requests.description: GEN:256 expands to 256 numbered neutral lines (~2500 tokens, exceeds default min_kv 1024). The operator materializes the literal prompt text when writing requests.json.

payload.prompt: GEN:256:Follow-up %04d: neutral reference material for state pressure.

requests.description: Same expansion rule as state-long-a with distinct seed/content.

payload.prompt: State chain interleave probe: follow-up reference material.
State chain stream probe: neutral reference material.
State chain cancel probe: long neutral reference material, repeated.

meta.metric_names: flashprefill_* names are the guide section 12.2 names MetricsIntegration exposes (missing series FAIL the case; no skip allowlist by design). Bare names sum all label series. Tri names below are verbatim /metrics series (tools/server/server-context.cpp): tri_drain_total, tri_maintenance_total, tri_floor_exhausted_total, tri_cells_freed_total, tri_score_seconds, tri_pack_seconds, tri_cells_before, tri_cells_after, tri_cells_freed, tri_references_removed, tri_target_references, tri_hard_keep, tri_shared_keep (tri_shared_keep evidences shared-prefix retention on drain legs). rerot_hard_aborts is NOT a /metrics series (it lives in task-result metrics only) and is therefore never referenced in expects.

A drain-save-restore-append.harness: state-a-drain-save-restore-append (FULL leg: save/erase/restore/append over long probes; expects sparse+corrected+rebuild+invalidation growth with both guide invariants)

C ram-cell-reuse.harness: state-c-ram-reuse-restore (PARTIAL leg: interleaved reuse + restore + long append; demotion proper has no endpoint)

F batchretry-streaming.harness: state-f-retry-streaming (PARTIAL leg: streaming terminal contract; shortage inducement has no endpoint)

H midprefillcancel-reuse.harness: state-h-cancel-reuse (FULL leg: cancel evidence + reuse + health)

harness_incomplete.B mtp-partial-accept-rollback: No HTTP endpoint performs MTP draft/partial-accept/rollback. C++ only: test_rerot_checkpoint_accept_reject (save_episode/load_episode accept-vs-reject incl. opaque mtp_blob checkpoint). Per-draft staleness predicate needs a live context (see test-rerot-runtime.cpp).
harness_incomplete.D rerot-publication: No HTTP endpoint performs RERoT private/public commit or view installation. C++ only: rerot_set/publish/reclassify/collect + generation invalidation in the state test.
harness_incomplete.E contextshift: No HTTP endpoint performs RERoT context shift. C++ only: test_context_shift_runtime_api (server_rerot_runtime::context_shift + truncate_oldest_public). Per-seq stamp roll-forward (llama_rerot_context_apply_shift) needs a live context.
harness_incomplete.G pensuspend-resume: No HTTP endpoint suspends/resumes RERoT pens. C++ only: test_pen_suspend_resume (suspend_pen/resume_pen + scheduler counts).

meta.no_fake_endpoints: Only documented step kinds (request, stream_request, slot_save, slot_restore, slot_erase, cancel_stream, health_check) and the documented /completion endpoint are used.

cases.description: Chain A FULL harness leg: long prefill, slot save, erase, restore, second long prefill (rebuild+sparse after restore), health. Expects sparse/corrected/pool-rebuild/plan-invalidation/visible growth plus both guide invariants (visible>=exact; sparse=>corrected).

Chain C PARTIAL harness leg: long prefill, save, interleaved other-request cell reuse, restore, long append. Same growth expects as chain A; RAM demotion proper has no endpoint (see meta.harness_incomplete only for B/D/E/G; C demotion internals are C++ clear_reuse).

Chain F PARTIAL harness leg: streaming completion with the harness-enforced /completion terminal contract (exactly one stop:true, zero [DONE], no trace/content leak). Short probe routes dense; expects dense-row growth only. Shortage inducement has no endpoint.
Chain H FULL harness leg: mid-prefill client-side cancel (evidence captured), new-request slot reuse, server healthy. Reuse is a short probe and routes dense; expects dense-row growth.
